payload.text: ST0029, Retire Python, holds until the 2.15.0 cut (hv decision 35). vc tells dc at the cut. Until then, nothing about ST0029 changes. At the cut, dc resumes ST0029 in Intent. Then dc does xtrct's goldens, then xtrct's zsh port, byte-exact, then the pdf2md spike. The port is byte-exact because xtrct feeds the Talga Rd accounting (vc decision 79 (2)). ST0029/02's draft stays banked at 48111094 on dc/st0029 in wt-st0029, never main.
